findings.title: Cohort is availability-selected inside the stop window, but only via counts/gaps rules that the frozen contract discloses and the review permitted; no value-magnitude or correlation influence on the stop was evidenced
evidence: rv_journal inside the stop window contains ok=false blocks with outcome_end <= stop (e.g. BTC blocks ending 05:15, 06:00, 06:30, 06:45, 08:30, 08:45, 09:15, 09:45-12:30; deribit_gex_eventstop_results.json:855-1208) whose reasons are exclusively consecutive_gap_gt_5000ms, too_few_in_block_observations_lt_720 — count/timestamp-based; no nonpositive_or_invalid_price or other value-based reason observed in journal entries dated before the 2026-08-31T13:00Z stop (results:841-1208)

disclosure is explicit in run-dir contract: deribit-gex-eventstop-contract.json stopping_rule.inputs_the_stop_may_read lists the parent RV availability rule verbatim incl. 'every price in the block finite and positive', and stopping_rule.note discloses validity-based membership
all four gate recomputations from the 15 included transitions match the reported values exactly (see recomputed_gates), so within the availability-defined cohort no arithmetic manipulation exists
findings.impact: Does not flip the falsified verdict; the falsification restates on four independently recomputed gates. Residual risk is confined to the ETH-side journal segment before the stop and the unverified presence/absence of nonpositive_or_invalid_price reasons (see unevaluated).

findings.title: Finding 2 (same-mechanism retest vs canonical next_gate) was resolved by owner authorization and disclosure, not by a pre-freeze canonical governance change
evidence: contract governance.owner_authorization.conflict_disclosed: 'strategy-registry.json focused_campaign.ranked_results[1].next_gate reads Any further work requires a separately frozen different mechanism... The owner directive retests the SAME mechanism with a different stopping rule. This trial proceeds on the owner's authority'

contract governing_authority pins strategy.json and strategy-registry.json; runner verify_pins iterates PIN_SECTIONS incl. governing_authority at load (run_deribit_gex_eventstop.py:171, 141-157) and twice before publication (:313, :318); results JSON pins_verified_at_publication contains both governing_authority entries with unchanged=true (results:336-347)

minimal_correction's alternative 'obtain an explicit owner-authorized canonical governance change before freeze' was NOT performed on the registry before freeze; update was deferred post-outcome per governance.post_outcome_updates
findings.impact: A governance/authority question, not a numerical one: it bears on whether the trial should have been minted, not on whether the executed arithmetic falsified the registered truth table. It cannot flip falsified to pass/inconclusive.

review_findings_implemented.evidence: In-memory prepare before any write (runner L260-288 prepare(); L308 called after preflight); existing snapshot aborts CRASHED before input read (L303-306); outputs preflighted (L307); snapshot published exclusively immediately before metric computation (L313-315); write_bytes_exclusive uses os.open O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_EXCL with fsync write loop (L258-273); no resume branch exists; run_budget text in contract outputs restates the aborted-rerun rule.

Owner authorization + exact conflict disclosure in contract governance.owner_authorization; governing_authority SHA-256 records added and verified at runner load (PIN_SECTIONS includes 'governing_authority', L40, L141-157) and before module load (L313) and publication (L318); pins_verified_at_publication shows both unchanged=true. Canonical registry next_gate itself not changed pre-freeze (deferred by design).

Contract stopping_rule.inputs_the_stop_may_read final bullet now states the parent availability rule 'AND every price in the block finite and positive (a nonpositive, nonnumeric, or nonfinite captured price marks the block unavailable, no imputation)'; stopping_rule.note discloses that availability inspects price values (validity, not magnitude) and that exclusions are recorded in rv_journal. Code path unchanged (fast_intraday.py:331-335 value checks, :389-397 append-only-if-ok, :447-465 counts transitions). Stop semantics remained unchanged; the review's preferred counts/gaps-only redesign was not adopted — the second disclosure branch was taken.

Commit barrier: pins re-verified immediately before parent-module load (runner L313) and immediately before publication (L318, emitted as pins_verified_at_publication); all three outputs written create-only + fsync via write_bytes_exclusive (L349-352) with no-replace O_EXCL semantics; owner copy published exclusively and its sha256 compared to the results sha (L350-352).

Contract governance.independent_review claims 'tests -> fail-closed lifecycle, RV-permutation stop invariance, multi-day dedupe, metadata boundary' were added and tests file sha b75867ff... is recorded in sha256s.txt, but the frozen test file content was NOT re-audited before the time-box; see unevaluated.
